status: PRE-CALIBRATION. Transparent rule-based router. Not CAT/IRT. All thresholds are operational hypotheses to be re-estimated after field calibration and standard setting.

locator.on_2_of_2: move_up_one_band_and_present_next_pair (if a previous pair at the band above already scored 0/2, bracket [current, current+1] instead)
locator.on_0_of_2: move_down_one_band_and_present_next_pair (if a previous pair at the band below already scored 2/2, bracket [current-1, current] instead)
locator.on_1_of_2: present_one_same_band_tie_item; correct -> bracket [current, current+1]; incorrect -> bracket [current-1, current]
locator.at_A1_weak_evidence: bracket [Pre-A1, A1] and flag preA1_confirmation (never force an A1 label)
locator.at_C1_strong_evidence: bracket [C1, C2] directly (C2 evidence comes from the upper confirmation block); C2 reported as 'provisional C2-level evidence'
locator.on_cap_without_clean_bracket: route to the two most plausible adjacent bands (based on last two results) and flag boundary_confirmation
locator.stimulus_modules_note: For RD/LSN a locator pair = one stimulus with its 2 items. A tie = one further stimulus; only its designated first item routes, the second item's response is kept as confirmation evidence.

confirmation.draw_rule: different constructs/testlets from the locator items; locator responses at the same band count toward the block when the pilot bank has too few items (record evidence_shortfall)

patterns.boundary_rule: >=3/4 correct at upper -> report upper; else report lower with 'upper possible'

extension.rule: >=3/4 -> annotate 'upper end of band; next band possible' (band stays upper in beta)

patterns.rule: descent >=0.8 -> report lower-1 (annotate 'lower possible' if lower block was 0.6); descent <0.8 -> report lower-1 with Low confidence and flag floor_unresolved; skip if locator pair at lower-1 already scored 2/2 (report lower-1) or lower is Pre-A1 (report Pre-A1, flag)
suppress level; add 4 items at lower; if lower now >=0.8 treat as upper-supported path, else report range [lower, upper] as undetermined with Low confidence

never: let one module cap another module

productive_route.base: median of the valid objective bracket lowers (LS, RD, LSN) -> route index
productive_route.lift_rule: if RD.lower >= LS.lower+1 AND LSN.lower >= LS.lower+1 then route = max(median, LS.lower+1)
productive_route.wide_window_rule: if max(lower) - min(lower) >= 2 across the three objective modules: route = median, flag wide_window, cap confidence at Low
productive_route.missing_modules: use the median of available valid modules; if none, default route B1-B2 and flag productive_route_default
productive_route.upper_extension: strong upper-level productive performance (upper evidence met with margin) -> offer one extension task from the next route where available

timeouts_and_technical.item_timeout: record omitted; score incorrect for routing; keep separate omission flag
timeouts_and_technical.disconnection: restore current item once with fresh timer (replay for listening); second failure on same item -> replace item / technical review, no proficiency penalty
timeouts_and_technical.module_abandonment: report only measured modules; label profile partial
timeouts_and_technical.persistence: every response persisted server-side on submit
